text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! I'm so sorry your plant arrived frozen and black, especially when you needed it for an event. That's really disappointing.

Under our policy, when a weather hold is waived, cold or heat damage in transit isn't covered by the Plant Care Guarantee, and Damaged on Arrival claims for cold or heat damage aren't accepted. So I can't approve a free replacement myself, and I don't want to promise something I can't deliver.

Since you're asking for an exception, I'll pass your case to a Support Lead, who can review whether anything can be done. I can't guarantee the outcome. To help them, please have these ready:

- Your order number (it looks like LF-123456)
- Photos of the plant and the box
- The delivery date

I don't have a set response time for Support Lead reviews. If you'd rather email help@leafy.example, replies come within 1 business day.

I can also offer a one-time goodwill store credit of up to $15 for the poor experience. Just let me know if you'd like it.

If you'd like help planning a replacement for your event, our Plant Care Specialists are available by chat 9am-5pm Mon-Fri.

Thank you for your patience. I'm here whenever you need me!
